cta.title: Choose your sponsor for season {season}
cta.body: Five sponsors are at the table, each with its own way of paying you. Compare the deals and lock in your backing.
cta.pendingBody: You have signed a deal for the upcoming season. You can still switch to a different offer until the season starts.

offers.title: Choose your sponsor
offers.subtitle: Five sponsors, five ways to earn in season {season}.
offers.unitDefinition: 1 race day = one stage your team starts. Not a calendar day.
offers.unitCount: Division {division} rides {count} stages in season {season}, so that is {count} race days you can earn on.
offers.unitPerDay: They are spread over {days} calendar days, so most days carry about {perDay} stages.
offers.divisionNote: Switching division here changes the rate per stage, not the totals. Your own division already sets how big these offers are.
offers.deadline: Your choice locks when season {season} starts. If you don't choose, the club signs the 1-season safe deal for you.
offers.empty: No offers are available right now. A new deal can be negotiated once the current contract is up for renewal.
offers.confirmBody: Sign with {sponsor} for {count, plural, one {# season} other {# seasons}}? You can change your pick until season {season} starts.
offers.boardNote: Board satisfaction adjusts the guaranteed part by up to ±20%. It does not touch race-day money or bonuses: those are paid in full, on top, as you earn them.

clause.signing: {amount} CZ$ signing bonus, paid up front
clause.podiumCapped: {amount} CZ$ per podium (2nd–3rd). Bonus cap: {cap} CZ$
clause.seasonObjective: Finish top half of your division: {amount} CZ$ at season end

contract.title: Current sponsor
contract.error: Nothing was lost and your contract is safe. Try again.
